_source: Scraped from https://newhorizonindia.edu/co-curricular/* (see scripts/scrape-clubs.mjs) plus the club logo folder. Fields marked simulated:true are demo programmes, not real events.

clubs.name: Aerobots Club
clubs.tagline: Skybound Curiosity: Where Minds Soar in Aviation Elegance!
clubs.description: Aerobots is NHCE's aviation and robotics club. It runs workshops and seminars, trains members in beginner and advanced robotics, hosts hackathons, and drives research initiatives in robotics and technology.

programs.title: Intro to Drone Flight & Aerodynamics
programs.description: Hands-on session on how fixed-wing aircraft and quadcopters fly, ending with a supervised flight demo.

programs.title: Beginner Robotics Bootcamp
programs.description: Sensors, motors and microcontrollers from scratch — build and drive your first bot.

programs.title: Aero Design Seminar
programs.description: Seminar on airframe design, materials and propulsion for student aircraft.

programs.title: Aerobots Hackathon
programs.description: Build a working aerial or robotic prototype around a surprise problem statement.

announcements.title: Welcome to Aerobots
announcements.body: Skybound Curiosity — join us for robotics training, hackathons and research initiatives. Sign up through our page.

clubs.name: Business & Information Technology Club
clubs.tagline: Empowering futures at the intersection of business and technology.
clubs.description: The BIT Club organises educational workshops and seminars, hackathons and tech challenges, skill-development workshops (coding, data analysis, digital marketing, design thinking, project management), tech talks and webinars, and networking events linking students, faculty, alumni and industry.

programs.title: Digital Marketing Skill Workshop
programs.description: SEO, social campaigns and analytics for student projects and startups.

programs.title: Design Thinking for Product Teams
programs.description: A hands-on design-thinking sprint: empathise, define, ideate, prototype.

programs.title: Tech Talk: Technology in Modern Business
programs.description: Guest speakers from business and technology on how tech is reshaping industries.

programs.title: BIT Alumni Networking Evening
programs.description: Students, faculty, alumni and professionals meet for mentoring and connections.

programs.title: BIT Tech Challenge
programs.description: Team challenge combining a business case with a small technical build.

announcements.title: Skill-building workshops this semester
announcements.body: Coding, data analysis, digital marketing, design thinking and project management — watch this page for dates.

clubs.name: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking Club
clubs.description: The Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking club of NHCE is a community of enthusiasts fostering knowledge and skills in cybersecurity: educating members about threats and best practices, promoting ethical hacking and responsible use of hacking skills, and raising awareness of cybercrime and cybersecurity law.

programs.title: Ethical Hacking 101
programs.description: Recon, scanning and exploitation basics in a safe lab.

programs.title: Capture The Flag: NHCE CTF
programs.description: Jeopardy-style CTF covering web, crypto, forensics and reversing.

programs.title: Cybercrime Awareness & Cyber Law Talk
programs.description: Awareness session on cybercrime, phishing and the legal side of security.

programs.title: Web App Security with OWASP Top 10
programs.description: Find and fix injection, XSS and auth flaws in a deliberately vulnerable app.

programs.title: Password & Privacy Hygiene Drive
programs.description: Campus-wide drive on password managers, 2FA and safe browsing.

announcements.title: Cybersecurity club is recruiting
announcements.body: We need passionate people to help run the most interesting cybersecurity events on campus. Register through our page.

clubs.name: Data Analytics Club
clubs.tagline: Transforming Data Desert into Oasis of Insights
clubs.description: A student-run club that equips students with the analytical tools needed in today's business scenario, giving technical and theoretical know-how of in-demand analytics tools so NHCE students stand out.

programs.title: Excel & Power BI for Beginners
programs.description: Clean data, build pivots and ship a first dashboard.

programs.title: SQL for Analysts
programs.description: Joins, window functions and analytics queries on a real dataset.

programs.title: Data Storytelling Talk
programs.description: How analysts turn numbers into decisions.

programs.title: Datathon
programs.description: Team competition: explore a messy dataset and present insights.

announcements.title: Follow us for workshop dates
announcements.body: Updates on analytics workshops and datathons are posted on our Instagram.

clubs.name: Entrepreneurship Development & Start-Up Club
clubs.tagline: Empowering Students to Innovate, Create, and Thrive in the Entrepreneurial World.
clubs.description: Through awareness, support and resources, the club fosters a culture of entrepreneurship at NHCE, promoting sustainable solutions and igniting the passion for business.

programs.title: Startup Ideation Workshop
programs.description: From problem to pitch: validate an idea in a day.

programs.title: Founder Talk: From Campus to Company
programs.description: A founder shares the first year of building a startup.

programs.title: Pitch Day
programs.description: Teams pitch to a panel of mentors for feedback and prizes.

programs.title: Business Model Canvas Lab
programs.description: Build and stress-test a business model with mentors.

announcements.title: Welcome to the Start-Up Club
announcements.body: Awareness, support and resources for student entrepreneurs.

clubs.name: EmSys Nex Gen
clubs.tagline: Unlocking the power of connectivity with embedded systems: where technology meets possibility.
clubs.description: EmSys Nex Gen is NHCE's embedded systems club — a community for students who want to build with microcontrollers, sensors and connected devices.

programs.title: Arduino & Sensors Bootcamp
programs.description: Wire up sensors and write firmware for a first embedded project.

programs.title: IoT Build Night
programs.description: Connect a device to the cloud and visualise its data.

programs.title: Embedded Careers Talk
programs.description: Engineers on working in embedded and firmware roles.

announcements.title: Elevate your experience
announcements.body: Register to join EmSys Nex Gen through our page.

clubs.name: Evolve.AI
clubs.description: Evolve.AI is NHCE's hub for cutting-edge AI events, activities and community — workshops, seminars, hackathons and competitions that foster creativity, collaboration and curiosity across all departments.

programs.title: Machine Learning Foundations Workshop
programs.description: Train and evaluate your first models with scikit-learn.

programs.title: Generative AI Seminar
programs.description: How large language models work and where they are heading.

programs.title: AI Hackathon
programs.description: Build an AI-powered solution in a day.

programs.title: Prompt Engineering Lab
programs.description: Practical prompting and evaluation for real tasks.

programs.title: AI Paper Reading Circle
programs.description: Casual reading group: one paper, one discussion.

announcements.title: Join Evolve.AI
announcements.body: Whether you're a seasoned AI enthusiast or just starting, there's a place for you. Explore membership options on our page.

clubs.name: FOSS Club
clubs.description: Empower your skills, unleash creativity, and contribute to a community of growth and innovation. Freshers and seasoned coders are equally welcome.

programs.title: Git & GitHub Workshop
programs.description: Branches, pull requests and your first open-source contribution.

programs.title: Linux Install Fest
programs.description: Bring a laptop and leave with a working Linux setup.

programs.title: Open Source Contribution Sprint
programs.description: Pick an issue, send a patch, get it reviewed.

programs.title: Why Open Source? Talk
programs.description: Maintainers on careers and community in open source.

announcements.title: Everyone is welcome
announcements.body: Freshman or seasoned coder — bring your enthusiasm and a readiness to learn.

clubs.name: Green Energy Club
clubs.tagline: Let's empower a sustainable future together
clubs.description: The Green Energy Club spreads awareness of sustainable technology and its impact on the environment, economy and society; advances education and research in green technologies and renewable energy; and champions projects and startups — through events, workshops, outreach, R&D and policy engagement.

programs.title: Solar PV Basics Workshop
programs.description: Build and measure a small solar setup.

programs.title: Sustainable Technology Guest Lecture
programs.description: Guest lecture on renewable energy and green tech careers.

programs.title: Campus Energy Audit
programs.description: Teams audit a campus building's electricity use and propose savings.

programs.title: E-Waste Collection Drive
programs.description: Collection drive with responsible recycling partners.

announcements.title: Projects & initiatives open
announcements.body: Have an idea in renewable energy, waste management or conservation? Pitch it to the club.

clubs.name: HealthXcel Club
clubs.description: HealthXcel is a nexus for people passionate about intertwining engineering and medical science: interdisciplinary collaboration, workshops with healthcare institutions, hands-on research and project-based learning, and networking and publication in healthcare engineering.

programs.title: Biomedical Instrumentation Workshop
programs.description: Read ECG and pulse signals with low-cost sensors.

programs.title: Engineering in Medicine Seminar
programs.description: Clinicians and engineers on building better health tech.

programs.title: Health-Monitoring Hack Day
programs.description: Prototype a health-monitoring idea in a day.

programs.title: Medical Device Regulation 101
programs.description: How medical products get tested and approved.

announcements.title: Welcome to Change
announcements.body: Uniting forces for a healthy tomorrow — join HealthXcel.

clubs.name: Innovation Club
clubs.description: The Innovation Club ignites passion, inspires collaboration and drives technological advancement by giving students a platform to explore, connect and showcase innovative projects that cross academic boundaries.

programs.title: Idea-to-Prototype Workshop
programs.description: Turn a sketch into a working prototype in a weekend.

programs.title: Innovation Showcase
programs.description: Students demo projects to peers, faculty and industry.

programs.title: New-Age Tech Seminar for Local Schools
programs.description: Outreach seminar introducing school students to new technologies.

programs.title: Industry Connect Meetup
programs.description: Meet researchers and companies working in different domains.

announcements.title: Get involved
announcements.body: Innovate, collaborate and create — it's never too late to elevate!

clubs.name: Mobile App Development Club
clubs.tagline: A community built on creativity and learning.
clubs.description: MAD Club advocates for the education and creation of modern apps in the mobile space through small teams building real projects: hands-on workshops, hackathons and design sprints, with 150+ participants at every event. Active since 2023.

programs.title: Flutter Crash Course
programs.description: Ship a first cross-platform app in a day.

programs.title: UI Design Sprint
programs.description: Figma to polished screens in one sitting.

events.title: Mindspark'23
events.description: WikiWhiz · UI Clash · CodeMaze — a three-round tech event with 150+ participants.

events.title: InnoWave'24
events.description: Trivial Battle · Pitchpoint — a two-round event with 150+ participants.

events.title: TechSync'24
events.description: Visual Recall · Car Racing · Construction — a collaboration between four clubs across three rounds.

announcements.title: New members welcome every semester
announcements.body: Whether you're into design, code, or bringing ideas to life — there's a place for you in MAD Club. Register on our page and follow @md_club_nhce.

clubs.name: RoboHorizon Club
clubs.description: RoboHorizon arranges workshops, seminars and industrial visits, trains members in basic and advanced robots, and promotes all-round development in robotics engineering.

programs.title: Line-Follower Robot Workshop
programs.description: Build and tune a line-follower from kit parts.

programs.title: Industrial Visit: Automation Plant
programs.description: Visit an automation facility to see industrial robots at work.

programs.title: Robo Race
programs.description: Inter-team race on a timed obstacle track.

programs.title: Advanced Robotics Seminar
programs.description: Kinematics, control and ROS for the curious.

announcements.title: Welcome to RoboHorizon
announcements.body: A commitment to precision, a journey into robotic excellence.

clubs.name: STEM Club
clubs.description: The STEM Club at New Horizon College of Engineering is a creative hub where innovation meets exploration — workshops, hackathons, idea-blitz competitions, coding games and maker projects, plus mega-events like Synapse '25 and signature formats like Builder's Asylum, Traffic 360 and E-Wasted.

programs.title: Builder's Asylum
programs.description: Signature build challenge: prototype under pressure.

programs.title: Traffic 360
programs.description: Signature event on solving urban traffic problems with tech.

programs.title: E-Wasted
programs.description: Signature event turning e-waste into working builds.

events.title: Synapse '25 — Event 1: Rescue the Lost Satellite
events.description: An intense, space-themed challenge where participants decode signals, solve clues and collaborate to rescue a lost satellite using logic and STEM skills.

events.title: Synapse '25 — Event 2: Mysteries of the Universe
events.description: A debate-style event exploring fascinating mysteries of the universe, blending scientific reasoning with imagination and passionate discussion.

events.title: Break Out The Code
events.description: A problem-solving event testing logical reasoning, teamwork and mathematical aptitude.

events.title: E = MC²: Quiz & Innovation Expo
events.description: A quiz competition along with an Innovation Expo bringing together innovation, intellect and scientific curiosity.

events.title: Mathrubasha Diwas
events.description: A vibrant showcase of culture and confidence, where participants display diverse talents across art, science and expression.

events.title: STEM X Borderland
events.description: An immersive event inspired by Alice in Borderland, blending strategic challenges with hands-on STEM learning.

events.title: Fresher's Stage
events.description: A showcase of creativity and confidence where freshers display diverse talents.

announcements.title: Investiture Ceremony 2025-26
announcements.body: Student leaders of all co-curricular clubs for 2025-26 were recognised at the Investiture Ceremony.

announcements.title: Welcome to the STEM Club
announcements.body: Learn by doing, network, showcase your talent and build career-ready skills. See All Events for inspiration.

clubs.name: Tech Forge Club
clubs.tagline: Driven by Tech »  Code ✦ Innovate ✦ Automate
clubs.description: Tech Forge is NHCE's co-curricular technical club (est. 2022): events, hackathons, seminars and workshops across AI & ML, web & app, cybersecurity, cloud, IoT & robotics — plus outreach like Helping Hands and A Day of Giving, and the flagship fest TECHFORGE '26.

programs.title: Full-Stack Weekend Bootcamp
programs.description: Weekend deep-dive into full-stack development.

programs.title: Cloud & DevOps Workshop
programs.description: Deploy an app with CI/CD on a cloud platform.

programs.title: Industry Guest Lecture
programs.description: Industry engineers decode the technologies of tomorrow.

events.title: A Day of Giving
events.description: A day of service at Sparsha Trust, Mathikere — Tech Forge takes its energy off-campus.

events.title: Helping Hands
events.description: Outreach programme: Tech Forge members step beyond campus to give, teach and uplift the community.

events.title: Kratos '24 — NHCE Team
events.description: Tech Forge members represent NHCE at the inter-collegiate tech fest Kratos '24.

events.title: TECHFORGE '26
events.description: The flagship national-level tech fest — hackathons, coding arenas, robotics battles, tech quizzes and keynotes. Code. Innovate. Automate.

announcements.title: Join 200+ builders, breakers and creators
announcements.body: Open to all NHCE students — no experience needed, just bring the fire. DM @techforge_nhce.
